title: tooling: a structural gate that refuses any method body in a facade file once protocol.ts and engine.ts land in facade form (ruling 6624258595)
body:
domain:server#6 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzibcN9oHa8kDbTTnL5

Filing gate: ruling 6624258595 on #29465 item (3). The maintainer named this gate and asked for it as its own tooling card. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Ruling-ref: 6624258595
Business reason: the large-file programme turns `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, #29985) and `ObjectQL` (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, #29986) into thin facades. Every public method becomes a one-line delegation to a facet class in its own module. Without a gate, the next feature lands its body back in the facade, and the file starts growing again. The ruling makes this gate the bar for these files, replacing the 13,000-line bar.
Reader who acts: `domain:server` or `domain:devx`, under `scripts/` beside the existing repo gates, wired into the lint workflow.
Dedupe (open and closed): `facade gate`, `method body facade`, `29465 gate`. The nearest are #29465 (the programme), #29985 and #29986 (the files), and #29520 (the pilot). None is this gate. **New.**

## What to build

- A gate that reads each file registered as a facade (first `protocol.ts` and `engine.ts`, after each lands in facade form) and refuses any class member whose body is more than a delegation to its facet. The ruling's definition of a delegation is a one-line forwarding call. Spell the exact accepted shapes from what the codemod generates, such as `return this.#facet.m(...args)` or its typed equivalent, constructor wiring, and field declarations.
- It refuses with the file, the member and a fix line ("move the body into its facet module and delegate"), and it reads a registry of facade files so the next split adds one row.
- Pins: the generated facades pass, a member with an inline body is refused, and a self-test runs over a fixture. Ablate once.
- Order: build it in the same window that lands the facades, or immediately after. Until it lands, the facades have no guard.

## Exception list (ruling 6624345766, added 2026-11-04)

Ruling-ref: 6624345766. Today's facade shape keeps shared state on the facade and lets a few hot bodies stay on the class: `update`, `insert`, `find` and `aggregate` on `ObjectQL`, plus any others the two splits report. The gate starts with each such member as a **named exception** in its allow-list. Each exception row names the file, the member, and the card that will move it (the state-owning facets design card). An exception without a card reference is refused, and when a member's card lands, its row is removed and the member must become a delegation. Exceptions are read from the two splits' reports on #29985 and #29986.
